backend/main.mo: Defines time tracking, media, journal, file storage types and maps, plus access control and user-role management logic for the backend canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report detailing affected frontend files, components, and test IDs for fixing an Android-specific UI crash.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend files including components, pages, hooks, styles, and deployment docs.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component handling authentication, profile setup, tab navigation, and rendering top-level pages within an ErrorBoundary.
frontend/src/components/DayTypeCheckboxG: UI component for selecting a single day type using styled mutually exclusive checkboxes.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary that catches render errors and displays a recoverable UI with reload and back options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with branding, version badge, authentication controls, and an admin-only publish retry dialog.
Mobile bottom navigation bar with icon-based tab buttons and safe error-handled tab switching.
frontend/src/components/PublishRetryDial: Dialog component to trigger and display status of a publish workflow restart using useRestartPublish.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes and caches a backend actor based on the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading, login, logout, and identity management via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, publish restarts, time entry CRUD, and related stats/media operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables with light/dark modes and custom utility/component styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/Calendar.tsx: Full calendar UI for viewing, creating, editing, and deleting time entries with daily media upload and playback.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page computing filtered time-entry statistics and rendering charts and cards for work, vacation, and on‑call data.
frontend/src/pages/Journal.tsx: Journal page managing daily notes with audio recording, photo uploads, day type selection, and CRUD operations via query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page filtering time entries by week or month, calculating totals, and allowing PDF report generation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme tokens, OKLCH color system, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting architecture, features, and known issues for the TimeTrack application.
